'''2001 Malmö team tournament (3 August)''' was a Star Wars CCG team tournament held in Malmö, Sweden on 3 August 2001. Akesson, Meijssen and Larsson (team: [[Martin Akesson]], [[Koen Meijssen]], [[Jesper Larsson]]) won it. It is known from Martin Akesson's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2813">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-09-the-european-tour-2001d2813/ the-european-tour-2001], DeckTech (Martin "Mart" Akesson, 9 August 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-09-the-european-tour-2001d2813/ GitHub Pages].</ref> It was played alongside the [[2001 Malmö Swedish Open]].

* '''Date:''' 3 August 2001
* '''Site:''' Malmö, Sweden
* '''Winner:''' Akesson, Meijssen and Larsson (team: [[Martin Akesson]], [[Koen Meijssen]], [[Jesper Larsson]])
